nodes.description: Address of the contract owner, set to msg.sender in the Ownable constructor.
Total token supply; set in STAR constructor and reduced by burn.
Mapping of address to token balance, mutated by transfer, transferFrom and burn.
Nested mapping of owner to spender allowances used by approve/transferFrom/increaseApproval/decreaseApproval.
Constant token name '7 Stars'.
Constant token symbol 'STAR'.
Constant token decimals, 18.
Constant initial supply 500000000 * 10**18.
STAR constructor: sets totalSupply and credits all tokens to msg.sender.
Owner-only function that transfers ownership to newOwner.
ERC20 transfer moving _value tokens from msg.sender to _to using SafeMath.
View returning balances[_owner].
ERC20 transferFrom moving tokens from _from to _to using spender allowance.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
View returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Increases spender allowance by _addedValue using SafeMath.add.
Decreases spender allowance by _subtractedValue, clamped to zero.
Burns _value tokens from msg.sender and reduces totalSupply.
Ownable constructor assigning msg.sender to owner.
Caller address, attacker-controlled; used for ownership, balances and allowances.
balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) in transfer — arithmetic balance reduction.
balances[_to].add(_value) in transfer — arithmetic balance increase.
_allowance.sub(_value) in transferFrom — arithmetic allowance reduction.
totalSupply.sub(_value) in burn — arithmetic supply reduction.
allowed[msg.sender][_spender].add(_addedValue) in increaseApproval.
oldValue.sub(_subtractedValue) in decreaseApproval.
Parameter _to of transfer.
Parameter _value of transfer.
Parameter _from of transferFrom.
Parameter _spender of approve/allowance.
Parameter _owner of balanceOf/allowance.
Parameter _addedValue of increaseApproval.
Parameter _subtractedValue of decreaseApproval.
Parameter newOwner of transferOwnership.
Local _allowance cached from allowed[_from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
Local oldValue holding current allowance in decreaseApproval.
Local burner holding msg.sender in burn.

edges.reason: Ownable constructor writes the owner state variable.
Constructor derives owner directly from untrusted msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == owner.
onlyOwner reads the owner state variable for authorization.
transferOwnership reassigns the owner state variable.
newOwner parameter flows into the owner assignment.
transfer reads and writes balances keyed by msg.sender.
_to parameter is the destination of the transfer.
_value parameter determines the transferred amount.
transfer performs the SafeMath subtraction on the sender balance.
transfer performs the SafeMath addition on the recipient balance.
Subtraction result is written back into the balances mapping.
Addition result is written back into the balances mapping.
approve sets allowances keyed by the untrusted msg.sender.
_spender parameter is the allowance key in approve.
approve writes to the allowed mapping.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spending spender.
_from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom.
Local _allowance is read from the allowed mapping.
transferFrom assigns the local _allowance cache.
transferFrom performs the SafeMath subtraction on the cached allowance.
Reduced allowance is written back into the allowed mapping.
increaseApproval performs SafeMath addition on the allowance.
Increased allowance is stored in the allowed mapping.
decreaseApproval loads the current allowance into local oldValue.
oldValue is the minuend of the SafeMath subtraction.
Decreased allowance is written back into the allowed mapping.
allowance view reads from the allowed mapping.
_owner parameter is the first key of the allowance lookup.
_spender parameter is the second key of the allowance lookup.
balanceOf view reads from the balances mapping.
_owner parameter is the balance lookup key.
burn is callable by any msg.sender and relies on their own balance.
burn caches msg.sender in the local burner variable.
burner indexes the balances mapping for the subtraction.
burn performs SafeMath subtraction on totalSupply.
Burn result is stored back into totalSupply.
STAR constructor assigns totalSupply = initialSupply.
STAR constructor credits the full supply to msg.sender's balance.
initialSupply constant initializes totalSupply.
STAR constructor mints the entire supply to the untrusted deployer msg.sender.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is an argument used only inside transfer and should be folded into that function node.
_value is an argument used only inside transfer and should be folded into that function node.
_from is an argument used only inside transferFrom and should be folded into that function node.
_spender is an argument used inside approve (and allowance) and should be folded into the approve function node.
_owner is an argument used inside balanceOf/allowance and should be folded into the balanceOf function node.
_addedValue is used only inside increaseApproval and should be folded into that function node.
_subtractedValue is used only inside decreaseApproval and should be folded into that function node.
newOwner is used only inside transferOwnership and should be folded into that function node.
Local _allowance only carries the allowance value inside transferFrom.
Local oldValue only holds the prior allowance inside decreaseApproval.
Local burner only aliases msg.sender inside burn.
